text:
Simple illustration of a dynamic digital image of a scene between a woman and two different men dressed in modern clothes, standing close to each other among tropical plants.
Close-up:
In the center of the picture, a beautiful young woman with long red hair, dressed in an off-the-shoulder turquoise dress, stands looking at the camera. She looks about twenty years old, has a slender build, fair skin, and has a long, aristocratic face. She is wearing a closed silver dress from the future. Dynamic pose.
On the right, the picture shows a young man with dark hair styled in an elegant hairstyle, dressed in a dark gray suit from the future. He stands facing the camera slightly behind the woman, with his hand on the woman's shoulder, and looks directly into the camera. He looks about twenty years old, he has a long aristocratic face with a well-defined chin, deep-set black eyes. Dynamic pose.
On the left, the picture shows a blond young man with an elegant hairstyle, dressed in a black suit from the future. He stands behind the woman, turning his head slightly to the center. He looks about twenty years old, he has a long aristocratic face with a well-defined chin, deep-set steel-colored eyes and a slightly open mouth. Dynamic pose.
Background: twilight, a romantic atmosphere reigns, thanks to soft lighting and details, and in the background you can see the walls with instruments and portholes of the underwater station of the future. Beyond the portholes of the station is the twilight of the underwater world.
The atmosphere is harsh, gloomy, noir-style, with extensive scenic concept art and rich textures. Futuristic style, high-quality detail, professional shooting, depth of field, detailed natural skin texture.
